mentions.h: IN MEMORIUM: R.M. 'MEL' THORPE (Born March 1938 - died November 1988)
mentions.note: born March 1938, died November 1988; joined from Coventry Godiva Harriers August 1963; best mile 4:19.8, two miles 9:04, three miles 14:13; Yacht '3' 14:37

share.d: R.M. 'Mel' Thorpe in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1989: 1 mention in 1 issue and 1 race result.
